description: 3 style-matched pre-war comic covers used by the collectible loot.
method: OpenAI Images API /v1/images/generations with gpt-image-2.5-flare, quality high, transparent background, PNG output; post-processed with Pillow to a padded 256x256 RGBA PNG.
reference: Original compositions in the Fallout Shelter item-art style; no game cover was traced or copied.
